singapore.title: Oil patches spotted in Singapore's southern waters; source under investigation: MPA
singapore.summary: No oil was seen near West Coast, Sentosa, the Southern Islands or East Coast during aerial surveillance, the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore said.

singapore.title: Heavy traffic expected at Singapore-Malaysia land checkpoints during Deepavali long weekend
singapore.summary: The Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) issued the travel advisory for Nov 6 to Nov 9, encouraging travellers to plan their journey ahead of time and consider travelling during non-peak hours.

singapore.title: Over 1,300 BTO flats with shorter waiting time of under 3 years to be offered in Sembawang in November
singapore.summary: Flats with a waiting time of just over three years at projects in Bayshore and Tengah will also be launched for sale in the November BTO sales exercise.

singapore.title: Police to use single caller ID 6000 0999 from Nov 2 to combat impersonation scams
singapore.summary: The call will be followed by an SMS from the "gov.sg" SMS Sender ID.

singapore.title: AI can make art in seconds – how are artists in Singapore fighting to keep their craft alive?
singapore.summary: From illustrators protecting their work from AI training to designers navigating commercial pressures, Singapore’s creative community is finding ways to respond to generative AI while preserving the human touch in their art.

singapore.title: Singapore haze: PM2.5 readings back to normal islandwide after west briefly enters elevated band
singapore.summary: The 24-hour PSI is forecast to be in the moderate range on Sunday, between 51 and 70.

singapore.title: Commentary: The invisible workforce helping Singapore age well
singapore.summary: Helping seniors age well takes more than hospital care, says Agency for Integrated Care Manpower and Talent Chief Derek Tan on Community Care Day (Nov 1).

singapore.title: Rare, roomy and pricey? Inside Singapore's niche jumbo HDB flat market
singapore.summary: With HDB reviewing the flat conversion scheme to create jumbo flats, CNA speaks with owners of such units about the attraction of extra space – and the extra cost.

singapore.title: Vintage watches, coffee and cake: Meet the couple behind Singapore’s Reference Room
singapore.summary: At Reference Room on Tras Street, Julian Chen and Claire Lim have brought together their passions for watch collecting and baking, creating a place where customers can browse, linger and connect.

singapore.title: Haze probe: Five Singapore-registered companies agree to engage assessors
singapore.summary: The five companies also agreed to cooperate with assessors from the Panel on Transboundary Haze, says the National Environment Agency.

singapore.title: Over 6,000 new homes to come for Toa Payoh West, with amenities clustered around Caldecott MRT station

singapore.title: Singapore's air quality remains in good-to-moderate range as haze eases
singapore.summary: The haze situation is expected to improve as inter-monsoon conditions set in, according to the Meteorological Service Singapore.

singapore.title: Fatal Tampines accident: Man charged with dangerous driving and fleeing crash that killed 2
singapore.summary: Muhammad Zulfiqar Abdul Aziz, 30, was remanded for investigations and will return to court on Nov 27.

singapore.title: S$100 for 12-course pizza dinner: Inside a couple’s home-based pizzeria in Yishun
singapore.summary: A shared love of pizza has turned into a home-based business. Limited space, demanding schedules and contrasting working styles are now tests David Shen and Sheralyn Tay must navigate, as captured by On The Red Dot.

singapore.title: 'Making history is a huge honour': Singapore's first WWE wrestler Dante Chen on his journey and what comes next
singapore.summary: Nearly 14 years after beginning his wrestling career in Singapore, Dante Chen is returning to where it all started. He tells CNA about his five years with WWE, his departure from the company and the next chapter of his career.

world.title: Trump says US looking ‘closely’ at report Nvidia CEO is target of China spy plot

world.title: Indian authorities tighten security ahead of big opposition march in Delhi
world.summary: Protesters are set to demand the resignation of India's election chief over a controversial revision of voter lists.

world.title: Bolivia declares state of emergency over El Nino
world.summary: Drought is affecting 78,000 families in six of the country’s nine departments, according to a government report released this week.

world.title: US campaign for control of Congress enters final weekend
Residents of Russian-controlled Ukrainian town arrive in Belarus

world.title: Shooting at California Halloween store kills one, wounds six

world.title: Pakistan military 'cautiously optimistic' on Iran-US mediation
world.summary: Pakistan's chief mediator in its efforts to de-escalate the now eight-month-old Iran war has been to Tehran twice this month, most recently on Monday alongside Saudi and Turkish officials.

world.title: Nations commit to get nature goals back on track at UN biodiversity summit

world.title: AI giants promise publishers new way to block some scraping
